name: Relay module (5 V)
description: A 1-channel 5 V relay board: an Arduino pin switches a separate circuit, even a high-voltage or high-current one. Power the board from VCC (5 V) and GND, and drive IN from a pin. When IN is HIGH (or LOW, for an active-low board) the coil clicks on after about 10 ms and COM connects to NO; otherwise COM connects to NC. The contacts are fully isolated from the Arduino. The red LED shows power, the green LED shows the coil is on.

trigger.label: IN turns the relay on when
